Compounds that are P-glycoprotein substrates are actively effluxed from the brain — basic amines with MW > 400 and moderate lipophilicity are common Pgp substrates. Charged molecules at pH 7.4 (carboxylates, sulfonates, phosphates, quaternary amines) have very poor passive BBB penetration. High molecular weight (> 500 Da).
